passages.text: At that time the LORD said to me, “Chisel out two stone tablets like the originals, come up to Me on the mountain, and make an ark of wood.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to me at that time.
He gave me clear instructions.
He told me to chisel out two stone tablets.
These tablets must be like the first ones.
He told me to come up to Him on the mountain.
He also told me to make an ark out of wood.
passages.original: בָּעֵ֨ת הַהִ֜וא אָמַ֧ר יְהוָ֣ה אֵלַ֗י פְּסָל־ לְךָ֞ שְׁנֵֽי־ לֻוחֹ֤ת אֲבָנִים֙ כָּרִ֣אשֹׁנִ֔ים וַעֲלֵ֥ה אֵלַ֖י הָהָ֑רָה וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ לְּךָ֖ אֲר֥וֹן עֵֽץ׃

passages.text: And I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke; and you are to place them in the ark.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God told Moses to make two new stone tablets.
God said He would write on these tablets.
God would write the same words that were on the first tablets.
Moses had broken the first tablets.
God commanded Moses to put the new tablets in the wooden ark.
passages.original: וְאֶכְתֹּב֙ עַל־ הַלֻּחֹ֔ת אֶת־ הַדְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָי֛וּ עַל־ הַלֻּחֹ֥ת הָרִאשֹׁנִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר שִׁבַּ֑רְתָּ וְשַׂמְתָּ֖ם בָּאָרֽוֹן׃

passages.text: So I made an ark of acacia wood, chiseled out two stone tablets like the originals, and went up the mountain with the two tablets in my hands.
passages.sermon:
Moses obeyed the LORD.
I made an ark from acacia wood.
I chiseled out two stone tablets.
These tablets were like the first ones.
I went up the mountain.
I carried the two tablets in my hands.
passages.original: וָאַ֤עַשׂ אֲרוֹן֙ עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֔ים וָאֶפְסֹ֛ל שְׁנֵי־ לֻחֹ֥ת אֲבָנִ֖ים כָּרִאשֹׁנִ֑ים וָאַ֣עַל הָהָ֔רָה וּשְׁנֵ֥י הַלֻּחֹ֖ת בְּיָדִֽי׃

passages.text: And the LORD wrote on the tablets what had been written previously, the Ten Commandments that He had spoken to you on the mountain out of the fire on the day of the assembly. The LORD gave them to me, and I went back down the mountain and placed the tablets in the ark I had made, as the LORD had commanded me; and there they have remained.
passages.sermon:
The LORD wrote on the tablets.
He wrote the same words as before.
He wrote the Ten Commandments.
The LORD had spoken these commandments to you.
He spoke them on the mountain.
He spoke from the fire.
He spoke on the day when you all gathered.
The LORD gave the tablets to me.
I turned and went down from the mountain.
I placed the tablets in the ark I had made.
I did this as the LORD commanded me.
The tablets are still there.
passages.original: וַיִּכְתֹּ֨ב עַֽל־ הַלֻּחֹ֜ת כַּמִּכְתָּ֣ב הָרִאשׁ֗וֹן אֵ֚ת עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת הַדְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּר֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֲלֵיכֶ֥ם בָּהָ֛ר מִתּ֥וֹךְ הָאֵ֖שׁ בְּי֣וֹם הַקָּהָ֑ל וַיִּתְּנֵ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה אֵלָֽי׃ וָאֵ֗פֶן וָֽאֵרֵד֙ מִן־ הָהָ֔ר וָֽאָשִׂם֙ אֶת־ הַלֻּחֹ֔ת בָּאָר֖וֹן אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֑יתִי וַיִּ֣הְיוּ שָׁ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוַּ֖נִי יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: The Israelites traveled from Beeroth Bene-jaakan to Moserah, where Aaron died and was buried, and Eleazar his son succeeded him as priest.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites were God's chosen people.
They traveled from Beeroth Bene-jaakan to Moserah.
Aaron was the high priest of Israel.
Aaron died at Moserah.
The people buried Aaron at Moserah.
Eleazar was Aaron's son.
Eleazar became priest after Aaron died.
passages.original: וּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל נָֽסְע֛וּ מִבְּאֵרֹ֥ת בְּנֵי־ יַעֲקָ֖ן מוֹסֵרָ֑ה שָׁ֣ם מֵ֤ת אַהֲרֹן֙ וַיִּקָּבֵ֣ר שָׁ֔ם וַיְכַהֵ֛ן אֶלְעָזָ֥ר בְּנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּֽיו׃

passages.text: From there they traveled to Gudgodah, and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah, a land with streams of water.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites traveled from their previous location.
They went to Gudgodah.
They left Gudgodah.
They traveled to Jotbathah.
Jotbathah is a land with streams of water.
passages.original: מִשָּׁ֥ם נָסְע֖וּ הַגֻּדְגֹּ֑דָה וּמִן־ הַגֻּדְגֹּ֣דָה יָטְבָ֔תָה אֶ֖רֶץ נַ֥חֲלֵי מָֽיִם׃

passages.text: At that time the LORD set apart the tribe of Levi to carry the ark of the covenant of the LORD, to stand before the LORD to serve Him, and to pronounce blessings in His name, as they do to this day.
passages.sermon:
The LORD chose the tribe of Levi at that time.
He set them apart from the other tribes.
The Levites carry the ark of the covenant of the LORD.
They stand before the LORD.
They serve the LORD.
They pronounce blessings in the LORD’s name.
They do these things to this day.
passages.original: בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֗וא הִבְדִּ֤יל יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ שֵׁ֣בֶט הַלֵּוִ֔י לָשֵׂ֖את אֶת־ אֲר֣וֹן בְּרִית־ יְהוָ֑ה לַעֲמֹד֩ לִפְנֵ֨י יְהוָ֤ה לְשָֽׁרְתוֹ֙ וּלְבָרֵ֣ךְ בִּשְׁמ֔וֹ עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: That is why Levi has no portion or inheritance among his brothers; the LORD is his inheritance, as the LORD your God promised him.
passages.sermon: The tribe of Levi does not have a portion or inheritance with their brothers.\r\nThe LORD is Levi’s inheritance.\r\nThe LORD your God promised this to Levi.
passages.original: עַל־ כֵּ֞ן לֹֽא־ הָיָ֧ה לְלֵוִ֛י חֵ֥לֶק וְנַחֲלָ֖ה עִם־ אֶחָ֑יו יְהוָה֙ ה֣וּא נַחֲלָת֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ לֽוֹ׃

passages.text: I stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights, like the first time, and that time the LORD again listened to me and agreed not to destroy you.
passages.sermon:
Moses is speaking to Israel.
Moses stayed on the mountain.
He stayed there forty days and forty nights.
This was like the first time he stayed on the mountain.
The LORD listened to Moses again at that time.
The LORD did not want to destroy Israel.
passages.original: וְאָנֹכִ֞י עָמַ֣דְתִּי בָהָ֗ר כַּיָּמִים֙ הָרִ֣אשֹׁנִ֔ים אַרְבָּעִ֣ים י֔וֹם וְאַרְבָּעִ֖ים לָ֑יְלָה וַיִּשְׁמַ֨ע יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י גַּ֚ם בַּפַּ֣עַם הַהִ֔וא לֹא־ אָבָ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה הַשְׁחִיתֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Then the LORD said to me, “Get up. Continue your journey ahead of the people, that they may enter and possess the land that I swore to their fathers to give them.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to me.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD said, "Get up."
"Go and lead the people."
"Walk in front of them."
"They must enter the land."
"They must take possession of the land."
"I promised this land to their fathers."
"I swore to give it to them."
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֵלַ֔י ק֛וּם לֵ֥ךְ לְמַסַּ֖ע לִפְנֵ֣י הָעָ֑ם וְיָבֹ֙אוּ֙ וְיִֽרְשׁ֣וּ אֶת־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ נִשְׁבַּ֥עְתִּי לַאֲבֹתָ֖ם לָתֵ֥ת לָהֶֽם׃פ

passages.text: And now, O Israel, what does the LORD your God ask of you but to fear the LORD your God by walking in all His ways, to love Him, to serve the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul, and to keep the commandments and statutes of the LORD that I am giving you this day for your own good?
passages.sermon:
Israel, listen.
The LORD is your God.
The LORD asks something from you.
He asks you to fear Him.
He asks you to walk in all His ways.
He asks you to love Him.
He asks you to serve Him.
Serve the LORD your God with all your heart.
Serve Him with all your soul.
Keep the commandments of the LORD.
Keep His statutes.
I give you these commands today.
These commands are for your good.
passages.original: וְעַתָּה֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מָ֚ה יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ שֹׁאֵ֖ל מֵעִמָּ֑ךְ כִּ֣י אִם־ לְ֠יִרְאָה אֶת־ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ לָלֶ֤כֶת בְּכָל־ דְּרָכָיו֙ וּלְאַהֲבָ֣ה אֹת֔וֹ וְלַֽעֲבֹד֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ בְּכָל־ לְבָבְךָ֖ וּבְכָל־ נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃ לִשְׁמֹ֞ר אֶת־ מִצְוֺ֤ת יְהוָה֙ וְאֶת־ חֻקֹּתָ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּךָ֖ הַיּ֑וֹם לְט֖וֹב לָֽךְ׃

passages.text: Behold, to the LORD your God belong the heavens, even the highest heavens, and the earth and everything in it.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The heavens belong to Him.
The highest heavens belong to Him.
The earth belongs to Him.
Everything in the earth belongs to Him.
passages.original: הֵ֚ן לַיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וּשְׁמֵ֣י הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם הָאָ֖רֶץ וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁר־ בָּֽהּ׃

passages.text: Yet the LORD has set His affection on your fathers and loved them. And He has chosen you, their descendants after them, above all the peoples, even to this day.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD loved your fathers.
The LORD set His affection on your fathers.
The LORD chose their descendants after them.
You are their descendants.
The LORD chose you above all other peoples.
The LORD has done this even to this day.
passages.original: רַ֧ק בַּאֲבֹתֶ֛יךָ חָשַׁ֥ק יְהוָ֖ה לְאַהֲבָ֣ה אוֹתָ֑ם וַיִּבְחַ֞ר בְּזַרְעָ֣ם אַחֲרֵיהֶ֗ם בָּכֶ֛ם מִכָּל־ הָעַמִּ֖ים כַּיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּה׃

passages.text: Circumcise your hearts, therefore, and stiffen your necks no more.
passages.sermon:
God is the Lord your God.
God owns the heavens and the earth.
God chose your ancestors and loved them.
God chose you, their descendants, above all other peoples.
God is great, mighty, and awesome.
God shows no partiality and takes no bribe.
God does justice for the fatherless and widow.
God loves the foreigner and gives him food and clothing.
Therefore, remove the hardness from your hearts.
Do not be stubborn anymore.
passages.original: וּמַלְתֶּ֕ם אֵ֖ת עָרְלַ֣ת לְבַבְכֶ֑ם וְעָ֨רְפְּכֶ֔ם לֹ֥א תַקְשׁ֖וּ עֽוֹד׃

passages.text: For the LORD your God is God of gods and Lord of lords, the great, mighty, and awesome God, showing no partiality and accepting no bribe.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
He is God over all other gods.
He is Lord over all other lords.
He is great.
He is mighty.
He is awesome.
He does not show partiality.
He does not accept bribes.
passages.original: כִּ֚י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם ה֚וּא אֱלֹהֵ֣י הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים וַאֲדֹנֵ֖י הָאֲדֹנִ֑ים הָאֵ֨ל הַגָּדֹ֤ל הַגִּבֹּר֙ וְהַנּוֹרָ֔א אֲשֶׁר֙ לֹא־ יִשָּׂ֣א פָנִ֔ים וְלֹ֥א יִקַּ֖ח שֹֽׁחַד׃

passages.text: He executes justice for the fatherless and widow, and He loves the foreigner, giving him food and clothing.
passages.sermon:
The LORD your God is just.
He defends the fatherless.
He defends the widow.
He loves the foreigner.
He gives the foreigner food.
He gives the foreigner clothing.
passages.original: עֹשֶׂ֛ה מִשְׁפַּ֥ט יָת֖וֹם וְאַלְמָנָ֑ה וְאֹהֵ֣ב גֵּ֔ר לָ֥תֶת ל֖וֹ לֶ֥חֶם וְשִׂמְלָֽה׃

passages.text: So you also must love the foreigner, since you yourselves were foreigners in the land of Egypt.
passages.sermon: God commands you to love the foreigner.\r\nYou must do this because you were once foreigners.\r\nYou lived as foreigners in the land of Egypt.
passages.original: וַאֲהַבְתֶּ֖ם אֶת־ הַגֵּ֑ר כִּֽי־ גֵרִ֥ים הֱיִיתֶ֖ם בְּאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרָֽיִם׃

passages.text: You are to fear the LORD your God and serve Him. Hold fast to Him and take your oaths in His name.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
You must fear the LORD your God.
You must serve Him.
You must hold fast to Him.
You must take your oaths in His name.
passages.original: אֶת־ יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ תִּירָ֖א אֹת֣וֹ תַעֲבֹ֑ד וּב֣וֹ תִדְבָּ֔ק וּבִשְׁמ֖וֹ תִּשָּׁבֵֽעַ׃

passages.text: He is your praise and He is your God, who has done for you these great and awesome wonders that your eyes have seen.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
The LORD is the one you praise.
The LORD has done great wonders for you.
The LORD has done awesome deeds for you.
You have seen these things with your own eyes.
passages.original: ה֥וּא תְהִלָּתְךָ֖ וְה֣וּא אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ אֲשֶׁר־ עָשָׂ֣ה אִתְּךָ֗ אֶת־ הַגְּדֹלֹ֤ת וְאֶת־ הַנּֽוֹרָאֹת֙ הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֥ר רָא֖וּ עֵינֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: Your fathers went down to Egypt, seventy in all, and now the LORD your God has made you as numerous as the stars in the sky.
passages.sermon:
Your fathers went down to Egypt.
There were seventy of them in total.
The LORD is your God.
Now the LORD your God has made you very many.
You are as numerous as the stars in the sky.
passages.original: בְּשִׁבְעִ֣ים נֶ֔פֶשׁ יָרְד֥וּ אֲבֹתֶ֖יךָ מִצְרָ֑יְמָהּ וְעַתָּ֗ה שָֽׂמְךָ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ כְּכוֹכְבֵ֥י הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם לָרֹֽב׃
